notes.text: Determinism of the fixed run (False) relies on a full blocking GC.Collect reclaiming an object referenced only from a frame that has already returned; the NoInlining static local function is meant to guarantee this in both Debug and Release builds. Must be confirmed by run-snippets in the sandbox (build configuration is not stated in the guide).

The field-like event `Changed` is raised only in the unused method NotifyChanged; this is there to avoid warning CS0067. Even if a warning appears, it should not fail the build unless the sandbox treats warnings as errors.

Line 31 is the `AppSettings.Changed += OnSettingsChanged;` line counted 1-based in code.source (line 1 is the using directive). Some reviewers might also accept the body of Close (line 36) as the defect location; only line 31 is accepted because the prompt asks for the line that creates the reference.
Attributes on local functions in top-level statements (C# 9 and later) are assumed to compile and to make MethodImplOptions.NoInlining apply to the generated static method.
